title: peltogyne riedeliana
intro: Peltogyne riedeliana, commonly known as Amazon waterlily or Peltogyne, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Peltogyne riedeliana include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce pain, lower body temperature, and clear mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
